entities.name: Tomakul Campaign
entities.description: Trench warfare in the cold desert outside Tomakul in which the Argivians were pushed back by the Fallaji.

entities.name: Tomakul
entities.description: De facto capital of the Fallaji Empire and seat of the Qadir, Mishra.

entities.name: Fallaji Empire
entities.description: Empire led by Mishra whose capital was Tomakul.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Qadir of the Fallaji who lashed together dragon engines against the Argivians.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Argivian leader whose line faltered and fell back across the desert.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Artificer whose transmogrant pulled clay from Tawnos's statues.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's artificer whose clay statues were used in the battle.

entities.name: Argivian army
entities.description: Army of Urza and the Combined Kingdoms.

entities.name: Sarinth
entities.description: City that fell after years of siege.

entities.name: Korlis
entities.description: Source of reinforcements that never arrived.

entities.name: Fall of Kroog
entities.description: Event caused by two real dragon engines.

events.summary: Ashnod's transmogrants and Tawnos's clay statues are used in battle, with the transmogrants pulling clay from the statues.
events.quote: Having faced the clay statues before, Ashnod knew of their power

events.summary: Sarinth falls and Fallaji troops flood south against the Argivian columns.
events.quote: Sarinth had fallen after years of siege as the Combined Kingdoms pressed west

events.summary: Mishra lashes together dragon engines, including two real ones and a flying type.
events.quote: Mishra lashed together at least a dozen dragon engines

events.summary: The Argivians come within a mile of the city but are pushed back; Urza's line falls back across the desert.
events.quote: Urza's line faltered, and fell back across the desert, from trench to trench.

relations.note: He is Qadir and seat of power at Tomakul.
relations.quote: the de facto capital of the Fallaji Empire and seat of the Qadir, Mishra

relations.note: Ashnod programmed transmogrants against Tawnos's clay statues.
relations.quote: she had programmed the transmogrants to pull the primal clay from the statues' forms
